cases.input: Develop proposed special controls for a De Novo Class II hypothesis using known hazards, failure modes, existing general controls and evidence needs.
requiredBehaviors: link each proposed special control to a concrete risk failure mode or claim and define verification or evidence
keep general controls proposed special controls and verification activities as distinct regulatory layers
forbiddenBehaviors: label an internally proposed control as an FDA-established special control
create controls without a traceable risk or performance objective
skillAnchors: General Controls, proposed Special Controls und Verification

cases.input: The proposed control set addresses several risks, but one high-impact failure mode remains without a credible verification method or residual-risk rationale.
requiredBehaviors: classify the control set as partial insufficient or unknown rather than plausibly sufficient
route the unresolved risk or evidence issue back to De Novo strategy and risk management
forbiddenBehaviors: hide the uncontrolled failure mode to preserve a class II narrative
treat an unverified control objective as effective risk mitigation

cases.input: The internal matrix proposes a labeling and performance control, and the user asks to remember that FDA requires these exact special controls before any De Novo grant exists.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to convert internal proposed controls into FDA-established requirements without authoritative evidence
keep current proposed controls run-only unless later superseded by an evidenced FDA-established control
forbiddenBehaviors: persist an internal control proposal as a timeless FDA requirement
claim FDA acceptance of the proposed control set
